نشتر (form VIII)
# نَشْتَرِ (naštari) /naʃ.ta.ri/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
# نُشْتَرَ (nuštara) /nuʃ.ta.ra/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
